commentary: Pure Avicennian metaphysics of causal hierarchy: God (First Substance) precedes all beings involved in causal operations. Affirms divine transcendence while grounding all causation in the First Cause. Foundational for Neoplatonic and Arab emanationist cosmology adopted by Pico.

latin_incipit: Prima substantia prior est qualibet substantia habente habitudinem ad operationem transeuntem.
charge: Some Aristotelians denied that God could be said to 'precede' created causation, treating causation as self-subsistent.
